recipes.title: 强图形与字形层级
recipes.summary: 强图形与字形层级：借鉴样图的组织方式与视觉层次，替换为自己的主体。

facets.title: 画面组织
facets.instruction: Use a dominant geometric focal shape, a compact secondary zone, and generous separation between visual levels.

facets.title: 视觉表现
facets.instruction: Use crisp graphic edges and a limited contrasting palette. Render only user-supplied text; reserve clean space otherwise.

facets.title: 层次与光线
facets.instruction: Use flat graphic contrast and deliberate solid shadows to clarify the silhouette.

facets.title: 画面组织
facets.instruction: Arrange the subject with supporting illustrated details in a balanced decorative composition.

facets.title: 视觉表现
facets.instruction: Use printed illustration, restrained vintage colors, subtle paper grain, and ornamental accents without copying source wording.

facets.title: 层次与光线
facets.instruction: Use tonal separation between the central subject and decorative border details.

facets.title: 层次与光线
